'''David Kangas''' (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''Icebreath''')<ref name="dt-23975">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23975 QMC Clouds], DeckTech (David "Icebreath" Kangas, 16 June 2002).
